name: Hugging The Trolling Tower 💕
desc:
HUGGING The TROLL 
🎉 Welcome to the wildest, wackiest, and most troll-filled tower on Roblox!
🧱 Climb, jump, dodge—and get ready to be hilariously hug-trolled at every turn!
👾 Every floor is packed with unpredictable traps, surprises, and troll mechanics!
💬 Will you go for a friendly hug... or get flung off the tower? The choice is yours!
🎮 Team up with friends, troll each other, and race your way to the top (if you can)!
⚡ Frequent updates mean more levels, more chaos, and way more fun!

✨ Enjoying the madness? Smash that LIKE 👍, hit FAVORITE ⭐, and SHARE the game with your friends!
🎁 Want

📌 Inspired by "Troll Is a Pinning Tower 2 & 1" by rabbit_cotten. Their game is amazing – check it out too!
